desc:
An army of slimes is approaching! Build strategic defenses and use powerful attacks to fend off massive hordes of enemies! Expand your arsenal and earn new defenses as you level up! Can you emerge victorious against the Slimes in all 15 battles?


This is a recreation of an old passion project made over 9 years ago. The motivation was to see how much we could improve this past project. Here is a link to this old project: https://www.roblox.com/games/394773622/REVENGE-OF-THE-SLIMES
We also want to give a shout out to a classic 2008 Roblox game called "-<[ATTACK OF THE SLIMES: BUILD TO SURVIVE!!!]>-". As mentioned on our old project, it has been an inspiration! https://www.roblox.com/games/1845318/ATTACK-OF-THE-SLIMES-BUILD-TO-SURVIVE


Liked the game? Don't forget to leave a Thumbs Up(👍) and Favorite(🌟) . Thank you!
